title: Women, Infamous, and Exotic Beings: A Comparative Study of Honorific Usages in Wikipedia and LLMs for Bengali and Hindi

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the differential usage of third-person honorific pronouns and verbs for male versus female entities in Wikipedia articles and LLM outputs using logistic regression and prompt-based generation/translation tasks.
Evaluating the frequency of honorific versus non-honorific markers assigned to different age groups (juvenile, adult, old) across Wikipedia texts and controlled LLM text generation.
Measuring the application of honorifics to 'native' versus 'exotic' (foreign) entities to identify 'insider' vs 'outsider' cultural status differences in language models and Wikipedia.
Analyzing the correlation between an entity's public perception (famous, infamous, controversial) and the likelihood of receiving respectful honorific grammatical markers.
